🧭 What this is

The Beholder's Gazette already runs a free 5e Toolkit for Dungeons & Dragons. This is its Pathfinder twin: tools built for the Pathfinder Second Edition Remaster rules, on their own pages, so neither system gets in the other's way. It's free, with no accounts and no paywall, and everything you make stays in your own browser.

We're building it now. Some tools already work with any system and are ready below. The rest are being rebuilt with Pathfinder's math and will show up here one by one.

✅ Ready to use

These tools have no 5e rules in them, so they work the same at a Pathfinder table.

🎲 Dice RollerAny dice, any modifiers. Works for a d20 check in any system. 📜 Random TablesBuild your own tables and roll on them. 🕰️ Progress ClocksTrack rituals, chases, and looming threats. ⚜️ FactionsGuilds, cults, and noble houses with goals and rivals. 🏘️ TownsSettlements with districts, people, and trouble. 📚 World HistoryAges, wars, and fallen empires for your setting. 🌳 Family TreesDynasties and bloodlines, generations deep. 🗺️ Continent MapsA whole continent with nations and coats of arms. 📜 HandoutsWanted posters, letters, bounty boards, price lists. 🧭 Battlemap BuilderDraw a 5-foot-grid map and run it at the table.

🔨 On the anvil

GM tools

⚔️ Encounter BuilderXP budget by creature level against your party: trivial to extreme.
⏳ Initiative TrackerPerception or skill initiative, and conditions with values like frightened 2.
💎 Treasure by LevelLoot and currency by party level, items with item levels.
🍺 Taverns, Travel & DowntimeExploration activities, Earn Income, and weather on the road.
🏰 Sites & DungeonsMapped sites with Pathfinder hazards in place of traps.
🛡️ GM ScreenDCs by level, degrees of success, and conditions in one place.

Reference and player tools

🐉 BestiaryCreature stat blocks under the ORC License.
📖 SpellsSpells by tradition and rank, with heightening.
🧝 Character BuilderAncestry, heritage, background, class, and proficiency ranks.
🔀 Archetype HelperPlan a dedication and the feats that follow it.
